# `declarative-autosubmit-sensitive`

**Tool rule** · `error` · on by default

toolautosubmit on forms with credential or payment fields lets an agent submit them without a human in the loop.

A tool rule judges one tool from its own definition, so it runs everywhere: `lint()`, `lintTools()`, the CLI, the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler and the ESLint plugin.

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "declarative-autosubmit-sensitive": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "declarative-autosubmit-sensitive": "warning" } }); // change severity
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule declarative-autosubmit-sensitive=off
```

```js
// eslint.config.js
{ rules: { "webmcp/declarative-autosubmit-sensitive": "error" } }
```
